chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey Ch. 312 - Han Li Unleashes His Full Arsenal
chapter_meta_description: Han Li crushes the Black Wind Cultivators with a terrifying display of multi-tool control via the Great Derivative Art. Can the Young Prince's baleful qi save him?
og_title: Han Li's Ultimate Showcase of Power
og_description: Watch as Han Li, with cold precision, dismantles an entire squad of Qi Condensation cultivators, proving the true terror of the Foundation Establishment realm.
twitter_title: Han Li Goes Full God Mode in Chapter 312
twitter_description: A Foundation Establishment cultivator with a full arsenal and a killer instinct is a terrifying sight. Han Li shows everyone how it's done.

lore_anchors.definition: A set of three identical, linked fire-element magic tools. As a set, they are easier to control and deliver a more powerful combined strike than individual tools.
A powerful, large-scale trapping magic tool obtained by Han Li from a previous battle. It expands to a massive size and can seal enemies inside it.
A dark, demonic technique that generates a defensive aura of corrupted energy. Its special property is to stain and ruin magical weapons that come into contact with it.
A secret mental art from the Thousand Bamboo School that greatly strengthens divine sense, allowing the practitioner to control multiple magic tools simultaneously with perfect precision.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why could Han Li control so many magic tools at once?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because he cultivated the Great Derivative Art, a secret technique that greatly strengthens his divine sense and allows him to multitask with multiple magical tools.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What was the Sky-Covering Bell doing in this chapter?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Han Li used it to instantly seal away the transforming Blood Attendant, neutralizing the young prince's strongest trump card before it could be used.
